metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace that has Microsoft Sentinel enabled and the ConductAudit_CL table.

properties.displayName: Conduct - Repeated Guard blocks from one agent or user
properties.description: An agent identity or user was blocked by Guard at least `threshold` times within one window. Repeated blocks usually mean an agent is probing a policy boundary or is stuck in a retry loop.
properties.query:
let threshold = 5;
let window = 10m;
ConductAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(20m)
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId  // the feed is at-least-once: drop duplicates
| where Decision == "blocked"
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(AgentIdentityId), tostring(UserId), tostring(UserEmail))
| where isnotempty(Actor)
| summarize Blocks = count(), DistinctTools = dcount(ToolCall), Tools = make_set(ToolCall, 10),
            Rules = make_set(RuleId, 10), FirstBlock = min(TimeGenerated), LastBlock = max(TimeGenerated),
            UserEmail = take_any(UserEmail)
            by Actor, WorkspaceId, bin(TimeGenerated, window)
| where Blocks >= threshold

properties.displayName: Conduct - Tool re-attempted after the approval was rejected
properties.description: A user's approval request for a tool was rejected, and within 15 minutes the same user ran the same tool again and Guard allowed it, with no approval in between. Approval requests carry the requester's email; the rejection shares `tool_call` and `rule_id` with the request. Heuristic: review matches, since a generic tool name (for example Bash) can be a legitimate retry.
properties.query:
let retryWindow = 15m;
let events = ConductAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId  // the feed is at-least-once: drop duplicates;
let pending = events
| where Decision == "approval_pending"
| project PendingAt = TimeGenerated, WorkspaceId, ToolCall, RuleId, Requester = UserEmail;
let rejected = events
| where Decision == "rejected"
| project RejectedAt = TimeGenerated, WorkspaceId, ToolCall, RuleId;
let approved = events
| where Decision == "approved"
| project ApprovedAt = TimeGenerated, WorkspaceId, ToolCall;
let rejectedRequests = pending
| join kind=inner rejected on WorkspaceId, ToolCall, RuleId
| where RejectedAt between (PendingAt .. (PendingAt + 1h))
| project WorkspaceId, ToolCall, RuleId, Requester, RejectedAt;
events
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)  // alert once per new event; the rest of the window is context
| where Decision == "allowed"
| join kind=inner rejectedRequests on WorkspaceId, ToolCall
| where UserEmail == Requester and TimeGenerated between (RejectedAt .. (RejectedAt + retryWindow))
| join kind=leftouter approved on WorkspaceId, ToolCall
| summarize ApprovalsBetween = countif(isnotnull(ApprovedAt) and ApprovedAt between (RejectedAt .. TimeGenerated))
            by TimeGenerated, WorkspaceId, ToolCall, RuleId, AiTool, UserEmail, AgentIdentityId, RejectedAt, AllowedEventId = EventId
| where ApprovalsBetween == 0

properties.displayName: Conduct - New MCP server first seen
properties.description: An agent called a tool on an MCP server (tool_call `mcp__<server>__<tool>`) that has no earlier call in the last 14 days. New servers are a supply-chain and data-exfiltration signal.
properties.query:
let recent = 1h;
ConductAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ToolCall startswith "mcp__"
| extend Server = tostring(split(ToolCall, "__")[1])
| where isnotempty(Server)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Calls = count(),
            Tools = make_set(ToolCall, 10), Users = make_set(UserEmail, 10), AiTools = make_set(AiTool, 5)
            by Server, WorkspaceId
| where FirstSeen > ago(recent)

properties.displayName: Conduct - Agent identity kill switch activated
properties.description: The `deactivate_agent_identity` action (the security kill switch) was called. Treat as an incident signal: someone suspected an agent was compromised or misbehaving.
properties.query:
ConductAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId  // the feed is at-least-once: drop duplicates
| where ToolCall endswith "deactivate_agent_identity"
| project TimeGenerated, WorkspaceId, ToolCall, Decision, AiTool, UserEmail, UserId, SessionId, RuleMessage, EventId

properties.displayName: Conduct - Audit hash chain linkage broken in the feed
properties.description: A feed event's `previous_hash` does not equal the preceding event's `entry_hash` (events ordered by time then id, per workspace). This indicates a deleted, reordered or altered row. It checks linkage only; run `conduct audit verify` on an export to recompute the hashes.
properties.query:
let settle = 20m;  // ignore the newest rows so late-arriving events do not look like gaps
ConductAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(3h) .. ago(settle))
| summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, *) by EventId  // the feed is at-least-once: drop duplicates
| where isnotempty(EntryHash)
| sort by WorkspaceId asc, TimeGenerated asc, EventId asc
| serialize
| extend PrevEntryHash = prev(EntryHash), PrevWorkspaceId = prev(WorkspaceId), PrevEventId = prev(EventId)
| where WorkspaceId == PrevWorkspaceId and PreviousHash != PrevEntryHash
| project TimeGenerated, WorkspaceId, EventId, PreviousHash, ExpectedPreviousHash = PrevEntryHash, PrevEventId
